title: Built4People Innovation Cluster – B4PIC

content:
B4PIC – Built4People Innovation Cluster is a network of stakeholders that promotes multidisciplinary and sustainable innovation in the built environment, in line with the objectives of the European Union and following the principles of the New European Bauhaus (NEB).

To this end, B4PIC is made up of one or more local or regional clusters, such as BUILT CoLAB in Portugal, and is supported and monitored by Built4People partners, including the European Construction Technology Platform (ECTP) and the World Green Building Council (WGBC).

  • Integrate the entire value chain: integrate as many different types of stakeholders as possible from the entire Built Environment innovation value chain.
  • Be multi-objective: various B4P objectives as well as NEB principles;
  • Cross-sectoral in nature: integration of different industrial sectors, whose members may be transdisciplinary;
  • Locally rooted with national and European reach: linking a local territory with networks at national level.
  • Being cross-border: interconnecting with clusters in other regions or member states, establishing and promoting interregional activities between two clusters operating in two different markets or local economies.
  • Giving access to testbeds and demonstration spaces: integrating and connecting to testbeds, pilot buildings, living labs or other facilities to demonstrate innovations and facilitate market uptake.

Institutional Subscription

BUILT CoLAB is committed to implementing a set of initiatives involving the entire value chain of the construction sector in Portugal and with an international focus, in order to disseminate and promote the adoption of the principles defined by B4P and the values defined in the NEB, towards a more sustainable built environment.

By joining B4PIC Portugal, your organisation becomes part of a national and European innovation ecosystem in the built environment, offering opportunities to:

  • To establish new partnerships with businesses, academia, research centres, public bodies and other stakeholders in the value chain
  • To monitor European opportunities for innovation, collaboration and funding within the Built4People framework
  • Participate in projects, initiatives and demonstration schemes, helping to test and accelerate innovative solutions
  • Share knowledge and best practice, and monitor trends relating to sustainability, decarbonisation, the circular economy and the transformation of the built environment
  • Enhance the organisation’s visibility and its links to a European network committed to the sustainable transformation of the sector.

Become part of this network. To do so, consult the subscription document here, fill it in and send it to b4pic@builtcolab.pt.

* Membership is voluntary, free and non-binding.
